purpose: Excluded synthetic static geometry; not a paper lattice, dynamics run, or diffusivity reference
decisions: Use unmodified source coefficients and physical cutoff; no fit to paper values.
Differentiate H and mobile Ni only; fixed Ni output is upstream zero by convention.
Compare arbitrary rotations only for nonperiodic geometry.
For XY periodic geometry, use whole-configuration translation and one-atom lattice-vector shifts.
Do not compare absolute energies between fixed/mobile partitions because a fixed--fixed pair constant is omitted.
Retain all cases and any failed checks. No dynamics or mixed-bead interpretation is authorized by this protocol.
